profile.title: Profile
profile.displayNameLead: Shown instead of your username around the app — one per language, switching with your language setting.
profile.currentPasswordPlaceholder: Required only to set a new password
profile.currentPasswordRequired: Enter your current password to set a new one

finance.title: Finance
finance.lead: Income and expenses, in one ledger.

form.amountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero
form.rateRequired: Enter the exchange rate for this currency
form.rateUnavailable: Couldn't get a live rate — type the rate you actually got.

stats.customizeLead: Show, hide and reorder the widgets on this page. Saved for next time.
stats.allHidden: All widgets are hidden — use Customize to show some.
stats.paceNote: Projection assumes you keep spending at this month's daily average — one big purchase early on will inflate it.
stats.noIncome: No income recorded in these months yet.
stats.frequentHint: Notes that repeat (like "coffee" or "grab") show up here.

desc.breakdown: Donut and ranked list, by category or across all subcategories
desc.changes: What went up or down vs the previous month or year
desc.pace: Daily average and where this month is heading
desc.trend: Monthly income and spending side by side
desc.savings: How much of your income you kept, month by month
desc.categoryTrend: Pick a category and see it across 12 months
desc.methods: How much went through each payment method
desc.top: Your largest transactions and the notes you repeat most
desc.rhythm: Which days and weekdays you spend the most
desc.flow: Where income went: each category, plus what you saved

budgets.lead: A monthly cap per category, in your base currency. Subcategories count toward their category.
budgets.allSpending: All spending this month (including categories without a budget): {{amount}}

addPage.quickHint: Type or speak one or more entries — amount, what it was for, how you paid, and when. They land in the bulk list for review before saving.
addPage.quickNoAmount: Couldn't find an amount in that — try something like "lunch 45rb".
addPage.quickAdded: Added {{count}} entry to the list — review and save below.
addPage.quickAdded_other: Added {{count}} entries to the list — review and save below.
addPage.voiceUnsupported: Voice input isn't supported in this browser — type instead
addPage.voiceError: Voice input stopped — check microphone permission and try again.
addPage.pasteHint: Tip: paste rows straight from Excel or Google Sheets into the table.
addPage.importEmpty: No rows found in that file.
addPage.imported: Imported {{count}} row — review and save below.
addPage.imported_other: Imported {{count}} rows — review and save below.
addPage.fixRows: Some rows need fixing — see the highlighted rows.
addPage.errCategory: This category doesn't exist yet — create it above or pick another
addPage.errMethod: This payment method doesn't exist yet — create it above or pick another
addPage.listeningHint: Listening — say everything, pauses are fine. Tap ■ when you're done (it also stops after a few seconds of silence).

settings.paymentLead: What you paid with — a label only, no balances tracked.
settings.baseLead: Every total and chart is shown in this currency.
settings.archivedNotice: "{{name}}" is used by past transactions, so it was hidden from pickers instead of deleted.
settings.name: Name
settings.modeConvertDesc: Every transaction and budget is re-valued into {{to}} at the rate below (the same way Money Manager's "data retention" works). Transactions already in {{to}} become exact.
settings.modeResetDesc: Delete all transactions and budgets. Categories and payment methods are kept.
settings.resetConfirm: I understand every transaction and budget will be permanently deleted.

export.title: Export to CSV
export.lead: Opens in Excel or Google Sheets, and uses the same columns as the import template, so a file can be imported back as-is.
export.onlyFiltered: Only transactions matching the current filters
export.badRange: Pick a start date on or before the end date.

access.title: No access
access.notGranted: Your account hasn't been given access to this page. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.adminOnly: Only administrators can open this page.

admin.title: Administration
admin.lead: Create accounts and choose which pages each person can open.
admin.pagesHint: Home and Profile are always available. Each ticked page shows up in their sidebar; unticked pages are blocked, not just hidden.
admin.isAdminDesc: Can open this page and manage members. Only the owner can manage administrators.
admin.isAdminSelf: You can't change your own role.
admin.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. They can change it from Profile after signing in.
admin.resetPasswordDesc: Sets a new password and signs them out on every device.
admin.usernameHint: Usernames can't be changed here — the person can change their own from Profile.
admin.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
admin.createdTitle: @{{username}} is ready — share these sign-in details
admin.createdLead: This is the only time the password is shown.
admin.deleteLead: This permanently deletes the account and everything that belongs to it, including their Finance records. It can't be undone.
admin.lockedRow: Only the owner can change this account
admin.isAdminOwnerOnly: Only the owner can grant or remove the administrator role.
